subject: general
question: A metallic sphere of radius 7 cm is melted to form a cone of height 28 cm. Find the radius of the cone.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of sphere = 7 cm

Height of cone = 28 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × R² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π &time
